chat.label: Conversations
chat.blank: Pick an agent on the left.
chat.blank_sub: Your whole conversation with it shows up here, and you can reply right from here.
chat.sup.hint: It sums up the sessions and hands them tasks. Start it in a terminal:
chat.sup.stopped_line: not running: answers with one turn
chat.sup.resume_note: The supervisor isn’t running: it answers with one turn, with its own tools
chat.attach_cmd.copied: Copied. Paste it into a terminal:
chat.act.fork_title: A new session with a copy of this conversation
chat.stop.label: Finish the session
chat.stop.note: The agent’s process will stop. The conversation is kept: you can continue it with
chat.not_indexed: This session’s transcript isn’t indexed yet. The conversation opens by itself as soon as it is.
chat.drop: Drop the files to attach them
chat.hint: The message goes into the session. Enter sends, Shift+Enter starts a new line.
chat.replying: The agent is answering the previous message. Wait until it’s done.
chat.confirm_takeover: The session will close in its terminal and continue here. Press “Send” again to confirm.
chat.peer_note: Goes as a message from the “Dashboard” session: the agent answers in its own session, and the answer shows up here
chat.no_files: This program takes only text from the dashboard: files don’t go
chat.courier.no_files: Files don’t go by courier: the session needs a takeover
chat.courier.take_over: Files don’t go by courier. Take over the session or send text.
chat.courier.text_only: The courier carries only text: remove the files or take over the session.
chat.send.offline: No connection to the server. The message wasn’t sent.
chat.send.busy: Can’t send now: the agent is already answering.
chat.quote.title: Quote it in your reply (R)
chat.files_not_paths: files must be a list of paths
chat.not_an_upload: The file isn’t one of the dashboard’s uploads: {name}
chat.text_too_long: The text is longer than {max} characters
chat.no_file_name: Couldn’t find a free name for the file
chat.bad_done: Needs a done field: true or false
chat.bridge.no_terminal: The terminal wasn’t found in the VS Code windows
chat.bridge.no_answer: The VS Code bridge isn’t answering
chat.bridge.no_code: The `code` command wasn’t found; install the extension by hand: {path}
